subject: CS478
filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 1 Arabic videos. English coverage is strong, with high-quality, relevant university lectures or conceptual explanations for all topics. Arabic coverage is very limited; only one suitable video was found for foundational concepts. For most topics, Arabic candidates were either irrelevant, on prerequisite subjects, or failed technical gates like duration.

coverage.note: No candidates directly teach Half-Edge; all were on prerequisite topics like arrays or stacks and failed the relevance gate.
The single highly relevant candidate [83] failed the duration gate (>3600s).
